what: The plan's Phase 2 gate: a 1 ns 1L2Y run end to end through web/run.html in a browser, under Playwright.
host: Apple M3 Pro, macOS 14, Google Chrome 155
command: MIR_LONG_RUN=1 npx playwright test test/browser/run.spec.ts -g nanosecond

throughput.note: Measured separately by polling window.__mirRun and the progress element at 10 s intervals during an identical run: 30000 steps in the first 180 s including minimisation, then 5000-step reports every ~24 s. It predicted ~40 minutes against the 43.4 observed, and it is the signal to use -- renderer CPU sits near 1% during a healthy run and is indistinguishable from a stall.

readers.pytraj: not installed in any environment on this machine, so VMD coverage is unverified

history: Two earlier attempts did not produce a result. The first timed out at the 90-minute budget for reasons never established; the explanation first offered (a Vite HMR reload) rested on a status line that was stale by construction and said nothing. The second was killed early on a misreading of renderer CPU as a progress signal. Neither is evidence about the engine.
